title: 第7章 逆天奇功 鸿蒙霸体诀第8章 初试牛刀 废丹变顶级丹药
content_zh:
但以他现在的境界，说自己是炼丹师、炼器师纯属扯淡。
一旦暴露自己的能耐，将会引来难以想象的麻烦，必须谨慎。
林玄尝试操控，心念一动，天地洪炉瞬间消失。
此时，金色天门又有符文飞出，凝成一部金色法诀——《鸿蒙霸体诀》！
“此为《鸿蒙霸体诀》，源自于鸿蒙帝经的锻体功法，能淬炼你的肉身体魄，让你修炼出世间最强大的力量！”
“鸿蒙霸体诀，来！”
林玄心念一动，金色法诀便飞至眼前，开始参悟。
这法诀玄奥晦涩，与鸿蒙帝经的金色符文如出一辙，常人根本无法读懂，他却片刻间参悟通透。
“好一部《鸿蒙霸体诀》！”
林玄被法诀的霸道气势震惊。
此时金色天门已经闭关，但可以在他的心神操控下随时开合。
这道天门展现的，只是鸿蒙帝经的第一页，后续的部分他现在无法打开，尚不知道会有什么。
退出帝经的虚幻世界后，林北迫不及待开始修炼。
下一刻却脸色大变！
轰！
鸿蒙霸体诀一经运转，便瞬间抽空了他的丹田。
饶是他帝气灌体改造过的身躯，都近乎虚脱！
“这么恐怖！”
林玄大吃一惊，冷汗淋漓。
鸿蒙霸体诀对玄气的需求过于恐怖，若非他的肉身经过改造脱胎换骨，也许会被吸干气血当场陨落。

他忽然明白，鸿蒙帝经为何要达到玄气境一层后才能开启，因为鸿蒙霸体诀过于霸道，没有修为支撑凶多吉少。
这，便是鸿蒙帝经的传承守护！
“现有的玄气无法支撑鸿蒙霸体诀运转，必须马上提升实力！”
为了变强，林玄一刻也不想等。
此时，密林中的天地灵气已经被他吸干，再待下去只是浪费时间。
原本他想到外门区域修炼，但在感受过鸿蒙霸体诀的恐怖之后，他果断放弃了这个想法。
外门区域的天地灵气虽然不错，但也好不了太多，在那边修炼不会有太大的进步。
丹药！
想要快速提升，他需要丹药的帮助！
炼丹？
不！
巧妇难为无米之炊，他虽有天地洪炉，却没有炼丹材料，根本无从炼起。
“先想办法搞点丹药或者炼丹材料再说！”
有了天地洪炉，炼丹炼器那都不是事儿。
当务之急，是要提升实力。
九天之后风云擂台就要开启。
也就是说，他只有八天左右的时间来提升自己。
时间宝贵，林玄立即行动，直奔外门弟子入籍处！
达到玄气境一层之后，他就是合格的外门弟子了。
按照惯例，需要在入籍处登记，并领取一份外门弟子入门礼。

这是天玄宗为了鼓励低阶弟子修炼设置的奖励。
虽然不算丰厚，但对目前饥渴难耐的他来说绝对不容错过。
“长老，我已经达到玄气境一层，前来领取入门礼！”
林玄来到外门弟子入籍处，向执事长老索要。
content_en:
But given his current state, it is sheer nonsense to say that he is an alchemist or weapon refiner.
Once your abilities are exposed, it will cause unimaginable trouble, so you must be cautious.
Lin Xuan tried to control it, and with a thought, the furnace of heaven and earth disappeared instantly.
At this time, another rune flew out of the golden Tianmen and condensed into a golden magic formula - "Hongmeng Hegemony Technique"!
"This is the "Hongmeng Hegemon Body Technique". It is derived from the body-building technique of the Hongmeng Emperor Sutra. It can temper your physical body and allow you to cultivate the most powerful power in the world!"
"Hongmeng Tyrant Body Technique, come!"
As soon as Lin Xuan thought, the golden magic formula flew to his eyes and he began to comprehend it.
This method is mysterious and obscure, and it is exactly the same as the golden runes in the Hongmeng Emperor Sutra. It is impossible for ordinary people to understand it, but he understood it in a moment.
"What a great movie "Hongmeng Hegemony Jue"!"
Lin Xuan was shocked by the domineering aura of the magic formula.
At this time, the golden gate has been closed, but it can be opened and closed at any time under the control of his mind.
What this heavenly gate shows is only the first page of the Hongmeng Emperor's Scripture. He cannot open the subsequent parts now, and he doesn't know what will be there yet.
After exiting the illusory world of the Emperor's Scripture, Lin Bei couldn't wait to start practicing.
The next moment, his expression changed drastically!
boom!
As soon as the Hongmeng Tyrant Body Technique was activated, his Dantian was instantly emptied.
Even his body, which had been transformed with imperial energy, was almost exhausted!
"So scary!"
Lin Xuan was shocked and broke into a cold sweat.
Hongmeng Ba Ti Jue's demand for profound energy was too terrifying. If his physical body had not been transformed and reborn, he might have been drained of energy and blood and died on the spot.
He suddenly understood why the Hongmeng Emperor Scripture could only be opened after reaching the first level of the Xuan Qi Realm. This was because the Hongmeng Tyrant Body Technique was too overbearing and without the support of cultivation, there would be many disasters.
This is the inheritance and protection of the Hongmeng Emperor Scripture!
"The existing profound energy cannot support the operation of the Hongmeng Hegemon Body Technique, and we must improve our strength immediately!"
In order to become stronger, Lin Xuan didn't want to wait for a moment.
At this time, the spiritual energy of heaven and earth in the dense forest has been sucked dry by him, and staying any longer is just a waste of time.
Originally, he thought of practicing in the outer sect area, but after experiencing the horror of the Hongmeng Hegemon Body Technique, he decisively gave up this idea.
Although the spiritual energy of heaven and earth in the outer gate area is good, it is not much better, and there will not be much progress in practicing there.
Pill!
If he wants to improve quickly, he needs the help of pills!
Alchemy?
No!
It is difficult for a clever woman to make a meal without rice. Although he has the furnace of heaven and earth, he has no materials for alchemy, so there is no way to make it.
"Let's find a way to get some elixirs or alchemy materials first!"
With the Heaven and Earth Furnace, refining elixirs and refining weapons is no longer a problem.
The top priority is to improve our strength.
The Fengyun Arena will open in nine days.
In other words, he only has about eight days to improve himself.
Time was precious, so Lin Xuan took action immediately and went straight to the naturalization office for outer disciples!
After reaching the first level of Xuan Qi Realm, he will be a qualified outer disciple.
As usual, you need to register at the naturalization office and receive an initiation gift as an outer disciple.
This is a reward set by Tianxuan Sect to encourage low-level disciples to practice.
Although it is not rich, it is definitely not to be missed for him who is currently very hungry and thirsty.
"Elder, I have reached the first level of Xuanqi Realm and come to receive the initiation gift!"
Lin Xuan came to the naturalization office for outer disciples and asked the deacon and elder for it.
